facts.fact: The National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA) is named as the Supervisory Authority under Law No 058/2021 of 13/10/2021 on personal data protection and privacy, and issued these standard contractual clauses.
facts.system: Law Nº 058/2021 relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy

facts.fact: NCSA's Data Protection and Privacy Office published standard contractual clauses for transfers of personal data outside Rwanda under Article 49 of Law No 058/2021, as compliance guidance with no decision attached.
facts.system: Law Nº 058/2021 relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy
